meta.title: feat: Implement configurable batch queue throttling to prevent resource exhaustion
meta.body_summary: Added configurable batch queue throttling with maxQueueSize limit, ErrQueueFull backpressure signal, and default limit of 1000 in single sequencer to prevent resource exhaustion during DA congestion.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot implemented configurable batch queue throttling with tests, and after maintainer-guided integration test addition, it was approved and merged within ~5.6h.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 881 changed lines across 8 files, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume, concentrated in sequencer and test files. It fits a moderate incremental feature addition for resource protection, and the successful merge aligns with the small-step, iterative collaboration pattern.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer Manav-Aggarwal requested an integration test to simulate DA failure and verify ErrQueueFull; also asked to bump MaxPendingHeadersAndData size and to wait for 5 blocks before simulating DA failure.
review_details.performance_claim: Prevent resource exhaustion by limiting batch queue to 1000 entries, providing backpressure with ErrQueueFull signal.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: unbounded_queue_growth (prior behavior; not in taxonomy enum)

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding configurable queue limits in Go sequencer with proper mutex handling and integration with dummy DA layer showcases effective technical capability; maintainer guidance was needed for integration test placement and scenario specifics.

detection_detail.code_reading: Manav-Aggarwal read the changes and requested an integration test to verify the throttling under DA failure, specifying test file and block wait.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: The PR includes tests that exercise the queue throttling, but no benchmark or profiling data for runtime performance; feature correctness is validated through functional tests.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Not applicable as this is a new feature addition with no existing degradation.

core_change_summary.description: In sequencers/single/queue.go, added maxQueueSize field to BatchQueue and ErrQueueFull error; AddBatch returns ErrQueueFull when limit is exceeded. Updated sequencer.go to initialize with a default limit of 1000 and log errors. Extended queue_test.go and sequencer_test.go with tests for throttling, concurrent access, and integration with dummy DA failure. Also modified dummy.go to support SetSubmitFailure for DA simulation and added integration test in single_sequencer_integration_test.go.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: full_node_integration_test.go saw net removal after test was moved; dummy.go gained SetSubmitFailure for DA simulation; helpers_test.go bumped MaxPendingHeadersAndData size.
